correctness.rationale: The source's uncensored U-statistic is reconstructed with moment-fitted Gamma parameters. Exact Beta moments and pairwise expectations give a(a-1)/[2(a+1)(2a+1)]; an analytic directional-derivative calculation and the implicit-function theorem yield a nontrivial local zero manifold. Exact influence calculations give uniform variance 7/540 and matching Gamma(3,1/6) variance 37/2592. U-statistic projection and delta method prove the Gaussian limits and 2Phi(-z sqrt(185/168)) rejection formula; 19 exact symbolic assertions passed in verify_gamma_blind.py.

value.rationale: The test is a published Gamma goodness-of-fit procedure, and the uniform alternative has exactly the same first two moments as the fitted Gamma null. An analytic continuum of non-Gamma Beta laws cancels its scalar departure, and at nominal 5% the uniform alternative has asymptotic two-sided rejection only 3.9711%, not consistency. The exact sign law also identifies an entire power-law subfamily invisible to a positive-side-only rejection rule. This is a substantive structural limitation with calibration implications, not an arbitrary invariant computation.
